channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Istanbul court opens trial of seven CHP mayors
item.description: An Istanbul court on Jan. 27 opened the first hearing in a bribery and bid-rigging case involving seven mayors from the main opposition Republican People’s Party (CHP).

item.title: Rare fish species torik returns to Marmara Sea after 40 years
item.description: After a 40-year hiatus, the Marmara Sea is once again teeming with torik, as a historic surge of the large-bodied relative of the bonito marks a triumphant return to the region.

item.title: Galatasaray eyes knockout berth in tough test
item.description: Galatasaray enters the final matchday of the Champions League league phase on Jan. 28 with its knockout fate firmly in its own hands, needing only a single point against a depleted Manchester City to guarantee a spot in the playoffs.

item.title: ‘Made in Europe’ policy should not exclude Türkiye: DEİK head
item.description: President of the Foreign Economic Relations Board (DEIK), Nail Olpak, has emphasized Türkiye’s indispensable role in Europe, particularly in light of the EU’s new “Made in Europe” initiative.

item.title: Türkiye embarks on 10th National Antarctic Science Expedition
item.description: Türkiye has launched its 10th National Antarctic Scientific Expedition, deploying a team of researchers to the continent to carry out vital climate and environmental studies in one of the world’s harshest and most remote environments.

item.title: Israel returns remains of last Gaza hostage
item.description: Israeli forces brought home on Monday the remains of Ran Gvili, the last hostage held in Gaza, finally closing the chapter on a painful saga that has haunted Israeli society since Hamas's Oct. 7, 2023 attack.

item.title: EU, India agree 'mother of all' trade deals
item.description: The leaders of India and the European Union will announce the "mother of all deals" on Tuesday, when they meet in New Delhi to formalise a huge trade pact reached after two decades of negotiations.

item.title: US, Iran tensions rise amid strike threats as aircraft carrier in Mideast
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has said the situation with Iran is “in flux” and confirmed he has sent a “big armada” to the Middle East, hours after the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln arrived in the region.

item.title: Ankara, Paris discuss ways to advance Türkiye-EU ties
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan and his French counterpart, Jean-Noel Barrot, discussed ways to overcome current freeze in Türkiye-EU ties, including modernization of the customs union and visa liberalization, as well as to strengthen the security of the European continent in a key meeting in the Turkish capital Ankara on Jan. 27.

item.title: Erdogan says Türkiye has ‘strategic partnership’ with Nigeria
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has said Türkiye and Nigeria have a strategic partnership, underlining the importance of political will and economic cooperation between the two countries, as he hosted Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for talks in Ankara.
